- [Seoul Subway Full Guide](https://mgself414.github.io/keychingu-content-deploy/content/seoul-subway.html): Seoul Subway 24 lines 750+ stations 12-pick — Line 1 (since 1974 Korea's #1) + Line 2 ring (50.2km foreigner #1) + Line 3·4·5·6 + Airport Railroad (ICN Express 43min / local 58min) + Line 9 Express (Gimpo-Gangnam 25min) + Shinbundang (Pangyo) + Gyeongui-Jungang + T-money 30min free transfer (max 4) + 4lang English/Chinese/Japanese signage

- [Korea KTX & Intercity Transport Full Guide](https://mgself414.github.io/keychingu-content-deploy/content/ktx-intercity.html): Korea intercity transport 12-pick — KTX Gyeongbu Line (Seoul-Busan 2.5h since 2004) + KTX Honam (Yongsan-Gwangju 2h) + KTX Gangneung (Seoul-Gangneung 1h40m for ski) + SRT (Suseo since 2016) + ITX-Saemaul heritage rail + Express Bus (Gyeongbu/Dongseoul/Nambu 3 terminals) + Domestic LCC (Jeju Air/T'way, Gimpo-Jeju 30-80K won) + Airport Limousine + Car rental with IDP + Ferry to Jeju/Wando/Ulleung + KORAIL Pass foreigner-exclusive

## Busan Series (Korea's #2 city, foreigner outskirts #1)

- [Busan Haeundae & Gwangalli Guide](https://mgself414.github.io/keychingu-content-deploy/content/busan-haeundae.html): Busan Series ① Haeundae & Gwangalli 12-pick — Haeundae Beach (Korea's #1 beach 1.5km, 10M+ annual visitors) + Gwangalli Beach + Gwangan Bridge (7.4km night view #1) + Dongbaek Island + The Bay 101 + Dalmaji-gil + Marine City (Korea's #1 skyscraper district 80+ floors) + Busan SEA LIFE Aquarium + X the SKY LCT (411m, Korea's 2nd tallest after Lotte Tower) + Igidae natural park + Dongbaek APEC Nurimaru + Haeundae sashimi market
- [Busan Jagalchi & Gukje Market Guide](https://mgself414.github.io/keychingu-content-deploy/content/busan-jagalchi.html): Busan Series ② Jagalchi & Gukje Market 12-pick — Jagalchi Market (Korea's #1 seafood market, dawn auction 5-7am) + Gukje Market (1948, 'Ode to My Father' movie set) + BIFF Street (Nampo-dong) + Yongdusan Park + Busan Tower (120m 360°) + Yeongdo Huinnyeoul Culture Village (Busan instagram #1) + Taejongdae (cliff + moonrise) + Songdo cable car + Bupyeong Kkangtong Night Market + Jagalchi sashimi + milmyeon (Busan's 1st-gen wheat noodle) + Nampo-dong dwaeji-gukbap
- [Busan Gamcheon Culture Village Guide](https://mgself414.github.io/keychingu-content-deploy/content/busan-gamcheon.html): Busan Series ③ Gamcheon Culture Village 12-pick — Gamcheon Culture Village ('Busan's Machu Picchu', foreign vlog #1, colorful stepped hillside village) + Sanbokdoro Ibagu-gil (6km road) + 168 Stairs + free monorail + Ami-dong Tombstone Village (Japanese colonial relics) + Choryang Ibagu-gil + Busan Station + Choryang Chinatown (Korea's #1 since 1884) + Gwangbok-dong + Busan Museum + UN Memorial Cemetery (Korean War UN soldiers, especially loved by Canadian/Australian/NZ visitors) + Busan Citizens Park
- [Busan Seomyeon & Jeonpo Cafe Street Guide](https://mgself414.github.io/keychingu-content-deploy/content/busan-seomyeon.html): Busan Series ④ Seomyeon & Jeonpo 12-pick — Seomyeon (Busan's #1 commercial district) + Jeonpo Cafe Street (Busan's #1 MZ cafe street with 200+ cafes since 2010s) + NC Seomyeon + Lotte Department Store Busan Main + Seomyeon underground arcade + Pusan National University (PNU) street + Kyungsung University (adjacent to Gwangalli) + Oncheonjang Dongnae (Korea's #1 hot spring with 2000-year history) + Dongnae traditional market + Beomil + Seomyeon traditional food (Hapcheon dwaeji-gukbap, Naeho milmyeon)
- [Busan BIFF & Film Culture Guide](https://mgself414.github.io/keychingu-content-deploy/content/busan-biff.html): Busan Series ⑤ BIFF & Film Culture 12-pick — Busan International Film Festival BIFF (Asia's #1 film festival since 1996, every October) + Busan Cinema Center Centum City (BIFF HQ + 4,000 m² outdoor LED) + BIFF Street Nampo-dong + Haedong Yonggungsa (Busan's #1 temple, sea-side temple foreigner instagram #1) + Gijang Jukseong Cathedral + Dalmaji-gogae + Cheongsapo + outskirts beaches (Songjeong/Ilgwang/Imrang) + Centum City Shinsegae (Guinness World Record largest department store 293,905 m²)

- **Target audience**: Foreign MZ FIT travelers (20-35) visiting Seoul/Korea
- **Coverage**: 106+ curated guides as of 2026-05-16
- **Languages**: Korean + English (web pages); Chinese + Japanese (PDF only)
- **Update frequency**: Weekly
- **Data sources**: Naver Maps + Reddit r/koreatravel + Google reviews + user curation
- **Contact**: @keychingu.korea (Instagram)
